Let me introduce the upcoming Events of Sid.

[h1]1.Season[/h1]

■ Period: 2/2 ~ 2/15 (UTC)

■ The following Season Exceptionals can be encountered during Lessons and Explorations.

[h1]2.Special Summon  - Valentine Sidians[/h1]

■ Period:  2/2 ~ 2/15 (UTC)

■ Valentine summon

During this period, there will be a <Valentine> summon under [Summon] menu.

○ You will get : 1x SR <Lussid Broadcasting Club> Sidian + 5x Magic Paper

○ <Valentine> summon % :
- SR Valentine Sherlock> 25%
- SR Valentine Houdini > 25%
- SR Valentine Beethoven > 25%
- SR J.J > 25%

○ Price : 880 Crystals

■ Selling <Valentine> Sidian.

You can get "Rainbow Hourglass" via "Sell Sidians"

○ <Valentine> Sidian x1 = Rainbow Hourglass x4

※ Amount of "Rainbow Hourglass" is not shown like "time space items" when you sell Sidians.
- You can check the amount of "Rainbow Hourglass" in the result popup.

※ Fusion number is reflected on the amount of Rainbow Hourglass will you get.
- 4/4 Fusion Max Sidian will give you 16 Rainbow Hourglass.
- 1/4 Fusion Sidian will give you 4 Rainbow Hourglass as well.

■ Changes of reward

* You can get "4x Rainbow Hourglass" from "Sell Sidians" <During> Event period. (without "Time-Space Shard".)
* You can get "5x Time Space Shard" from "Sell Sidians" <After> Event period. (without "Rainbow Hourglass".)

■ Event Sidian Summon Stone

During the event period, collect your "Rainbow Hourglasses" and
create an Event Sidian Summon Stone at the [Atelier].
○ You can turn 20 Rainbow Hourglasses into a Event Sidian Summon Stone.
※ Event Sidian Recipe is available for the event period only.

[h1][b]To user who are played the mobile game 'Sid Story'[/b][/h1]

We haven't seen you in a long time. 
Today, we're going to let you know a new beginning.
The adventures of the Sidians begin again in Steam.
Its name is "Sid Classic."
Mobile operating rights and rights to user data of the “Sid Story” are still held by Tripod Studios. Mobile services can only be resumed by Tripod Studios.
Singta can no longer run "Sid Story" in the mobile market.
So, we are going to start the service from Steam so that users can start their adventure in the Sid.
First of all, we would like to provide our game in Early Access service. We will continue to improve the game until the actual release.

1.The season goes faster than before (the period changes to one week).

2. The probability of a season boss's acquisition is more than double the conventional odds.

3. We have ruled out the summonses that consume Crystal that you acquire the Sidian by probability. We will listen to your opinions and decide whether to resume these summonses.

4. In the Forest of Confession, members of the Forest of Confessions Gardening Committee appear all the time.

5. After hearing your opinions, we will continue to improve the game.

6.We give 1500 crystals as a gift to all new users starting during the early access period.

The adventures of the Sidians are about to begin again with Steam Service.
With the generosity and understanding of "Sid Story" users, we will try to develop the Sid world again so that we can continue the story, such as "Sid Story 2."


Thank you.
